visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is seen sitting comfortably in a black camping chair next to a crackling fire in a hexagonal pit at night. He is wearing a black T-shirt and grey trousers. Behind him is a large white camper truck with an awning extended. The ground is covered in green grass. (2) The scene cuts to a wider view where three men are sitting around the same campfire. All three look at the camera and wave their hands simultaneously. The truck is visible in the background with lights on. (3) A close-up shot shows a circular embroidered patch on a camouflage bag with the words 'Stay Wild' and a bear illustration. Next to it, a small digital thermometer displays 22.8 degrees Celsius. (4) The camera focuses closely on the flickering orange flames of the campfire. It then cuts to a table where a dark bottle of Japanese sake with a yellow label and two small white cups are placed. (5) A handheld panning shot reveals the organized gear at the back of the truck, including a coffee brewing station with a portable light, a black kettle, and various camping containers. The truck has the words '虎吧咖啡' printed on the side.
